terms.comment: Classically a jester or buffoon (Plaut. Trin. 1.2.165; Hor. S. 1.5.52), which is what the card shows and what the English word means; only Andresian gives it for the card.
“The lucky card”, a description of what it does in the game.

sources: Lewis & Short: scurra · Lewis & Short: fortuno
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency: p. 51, checked against the searchable text of the book on 11 November 2026; p. 286.
